## What changed

Describe the user-visible or operational outcome and the affected package or service.

## Why

Link the Linear issue or explain the problem and intended boundary.

## Validation

- [ ] Focused tests cover changed behavior
- [ ] Relevant typecheck, lint, and build gates pass
- [ ] Generated artifacts are current
- [ ] Deployment or live verification evidence is included, or this change does not deploy

## Security and privacy

- [ ] No secrets, credentials, personal data, or client-confidential content were added
- [ ] New or changed network endpoints authenticate and authorize before accessing data or tools
- [ ] GitHub Actions use immutable full-length commit SHAs
- [ ] Dependency and permission changes are least privilege and explained

## Rollback

State the rollback command, commit, or operational procedure.
